caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with an oval-shaped top and four straight, tapered legs. The table is shown in a realistic style, with detailed wood grain texture in shades of reddish-brown. The front side of the table features a single central drawer with a keyhole and two round, gold-colored handles, one on each side of the drawer. The table’s front legs have narrow, lighter inlaid designs running vertically down their length, and there is a decorative curved apron beneath the tabletop on both sides. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background without any additional objects or scenery. title: Hepplewhite Drop Leaf Table
